attribution.title: Fintech World Cup at Port City Colombo
attribution.author: PortCCX
attribution.description:
The Fintech Association of Sri Lanka (FASL), in partnership with Port City Colombo, recently hosted the Regional Competition of the FinTech World Cup (FWC) at Port City Colombo.

Organised by Trescon and powered by Ignyte, the FWC is a global platform accelerating fintech startups, offering Sri Lankan innovators a chance to pitch on an international stage. Finalists advance to the Grand Finale at the Dubai FinTech Summit, organised by DIFC and held under the patronage of Sheikh Maktoum bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

The initiative supports Port City Colombo’s vision of becoming a premier offshore financial centre and innovation hub.
